items.description: H1: No colon appears in a governed prose zone; syntax, code, URLs, math, and other documented exemptions remain intact.
H2: No mid-sentence em dash introduces a list or appositive; title-position separators remain allowed.
H3: No slot-filler opener, takeaway announcement, or content-free transition remains.
H4: No decorative pullquote, signpost heading, heading restatement, or unsanctioned list appears in running prose.
H5: Drugim riječima, Naime, Točnije, Ukratko, Jednostavnije rečeno, and Štoviše occur at most once in total and only when earned.
H6: Titles and headings are nominal, unnumbered, and colon-free; an em dash is used only when a separator is needed.
H7: Every specific number, percentage, named study, or empirical finding carries a verified citation in the same sentence.
H8: Bold is limited to first-mention concept anchors, definition terms, and documented structural exceptions.
H9: Every symbol receives a prose gloss, every display formula follows intuition, and notation stays consistent book-wide.
